title: PR body r2-fold header cites sha 8a6f3f5, which does not exist in git (the fix commit is 1cb1b4b)
evidence: File line 59: "## r2 fold (Perkins r1 @48c0e82 → 8a6f3f5)". Verified against git: `git rev-parse --verify 8a6f3f5` → "fatal: Not a valid object name 8a6f3f5"; `git log --oneline -2` → "1cb1b4b fix: Perkins r1 — B1 queue-row glyph collision + W2/W3 test gaps + notes" / "48c0e82 feat: honest utilization counters + network-native units (v2-network-units)".
detail: The r2 fold is attributed to a sha that resolves to no object in this repository; the actual r1→r2 pair is 48c0e82→1cb1b4b. Committed PR-body artifact misidentifies the fix commit.
recommended_fix: Correct the header to "(Perkins r1 @48c0e82 → 1cb1b4b)" in _pr_body_network_units.md (and the PR description if it was pasted from it).

title: Queue-row draw loop lacks the amber_pct > 0 guard that noc_queue_rows (and its new test pin) has — row-for-row desync at amber_pct == 0 (latent)
evidence: noc_overlay.odin:570-571: "// MUST agree with draw_noc_panel row-for-row (same count predicates + the // SAME visible-row caps)." Count side, line 602: "if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] > 0 || (amber_pct > 0 && p.util_pct >= u32(amber_pct)) {" — draw side, line 772: "if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] == 0 && p.util_pct < u32(amber_pct) {" (no amber_pct > 0 guard; contrast the PIPES draw at line 833: "if cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct <= 0 || p.util_pct < u32(cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct) {"). New test pin, noc_overlay_test.odin:321: "testing.expect_value(t, noc_queue_rows(&sr, 0), i32(1))  // amber 0 = only the queued pipe".
detail: At amber_pct == 0 the count includes only queued pipes (the fix's own test pins this) but the draw loop's `util_pct < u32(0)` is never true, so every pipe draws a queue row — the count/draw invariant breaks (scroll clamp undercounts). Latent: catalog validation rejects it (catalog.odin:952 "b.warnings.pipe_amber_pct < 1 ||"), so unreachable via balance.json.
recommended_fix: Mirror the PIPES draw guard: `if p.q[0]+p.q[1]+p.q[2] == 0 && (amber_pct <= 0 || p.util_pct < u32(amber_pct)) { continue }` so the draw predicate matches the test-pinned count semantics.

title: B1 fix comment's font metrics assume a 10.8 px/glyph advance; the shipped pipeline renders 8.156 px @18 — actual clearance is ~22 px, not the claimed 12
evidence: noc_overlay.odin:791-794: "// 104 + bar 64 put the count's ink at [px+351.2, px+359.6] // (advance end ~px+360.8); util_r at px+416 puts \"100%\"'s first // glyph at ~px+372.8 — 12 px clearance". Verified against the pipeline: ibm_plex_mono_regular.ttf hmtx advance 600/1000 upm, hhea ascent 1025 descent -275; LoadFontData @FONT_BASE_SIZE 64 uses stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight (stb_truetype.h: "scale = pixels / (ascent - descent)" → 64/1300) → advanceX = (int)(600×0.04923) = 29; raylib 6.0 MeasureTextEx: "textSize.x = tempTextWidth*scaleFactor + (float)((tempByteCounter - 1)*spacing);" → @18px advance 29×18/64 = 8.156, "100%" width 4×8.156+3 = 35.6 → first glyph px+416−35.6 = px+380.4; count advance end px+350+8.2 = px+358.2.
detail: The comment's absolute pixel claims (ink 351.2–359.6, advance end 360.8, first glyph 372.8, 12 px clearance) come from a 0.6em×18px advance model raylib/stbtt does not use. Real positions: count ink ends ~px+357.9, "100%" starts ~px+380.4, clearance ≈22 px. Harmless direction (the fix has MORE margin than claimed) but the recorded metrics are wrong.
recommended_fix: Recompute the comment with the pipeline's real metrics (advanceX 29 @ base 64 → 8.156 px @18; clearance ≈22 px) or drop the absolute pixel figures and state the invariant (count advance end < util first glyph).

title: Spec artifact still lists line_rate_bytes_per_tick as a shipped core/units.odin helper; the code never defines it
evidence: Spec artifact lines 59-61: "   - `transit_ticks(pb, cap)`, `line_rate_bps(pb, cap, hz)`, /     `line_rate_bytes_per_tick(...)` (= frame_bytes/transit — the honest /     reference), `util_pct_window(served, w, pb, cap)`, `format_rate(bps)`". Grep over the worktree: `line_rate_bytes_per_tick` matches only this .md and _pr_body_network_units.md ("N8 `line_rate_bytes_per_tick` removed (dead)") — zero .odin references; core/units.odin defines transit_ticks, line_rate_bps, served_to_octets, util_pct_window, format_rate, format_bytes, format_rate_compact only.
detail: The PR's own implementation-spec artifact describes a helper the shipped code removed in the r2 fold (PR body acknowledges the removal as N8). Internal doc drift between the artifact and the code.
recommended_fix: Strike `line_rate_bytes_per_tick(...)` from the spec artifact's core/units.odin helper list (or annotate it as removed-in-r2 like the PR body does).

title: node_health doc comment still shows the pre-diff trace format "util 150%  (load 120 / 80 u)"
evidence: Line 40: "// \"util 150%  (load 120 / 80 u)\". Reads the 5.2 measure helper directly (the". The code this diff installed at line 111: "trace := fmt.tprintf(\"%d%% (load %s / %s)\", pct, pp.format_bytes(load_bytes), node_rate)" — the diff's own inline comment at lines 105-109 shows the new format: "// pipes). \"util 150% (load 1.5 KiB / 33 Mbps)\" — a 🔴 node stays".
